authority.qualification: Actual isolated pinned Store/Mixin quote, SQL eligibility/reservation, forwarding and manual recording algorithms, actual source schemas and SQLite3, actual validator and WASM signing. Native transaction wrapper/message adapter, owned clock, database and no-op mail. Independent reset branches are not live rollback. Direct inner-transaction admission, not full browser/peer initialization or consensus. No network, real funds or external payout.
